summary: The diff implements most of the requested requirements. REQ-1 (backend Order type extension + migration), REQ-2 (Cart checkout form with validation), REQ-3 (AdminOrders inline card redesign), and REQ-4 (OrderDetailModal customer fields) are all addressed. However, the backend field naming uses different conventions than specified (e.g., 'phoneNumber' instead of 'phone', 'addressLine1/addressLine2' instead of 'street', 'pincode' instead of 'postalCode'). Migration.mo handles existing order preservation. The Cart.tsx form collects all required fields with validation.

missing_requirements.requirement: The spec requires fields named: fullName, email, phone, street, city, postalCode, orderNotes. The backend uses phoneNumber, addressLine1/addressLine2, pincode instead of phone, street, postalCode.
missing_requirements.reason: The field names in the backend GuestDetails type differ from the spec: 'phone' becomes 'phoneNumber', 'street' becomes 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2', 'postalCode' becomes 'pincode'. The exact field names specified in REQ-1 acceptance criteria are not matched.

hallucinated_features.description: ProductCard.tsx and ProductDetail.tsx updated with empty guestDetails passed to createOrder for Buy Now flows
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request did not request updating Buy Now flows in ProductCard or ProductDetail pages. These are additional changes not mentioned in any requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: Inline fulfillment status dropdown added directly in the AdminOrders card component allowing status updates without opening a modal
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-3 only requested displaying order status inline, not providing an inline status update control. The spec does not mention adding status-change functionality to the orders list view.
